note: Chrome probe of the events each synchronously dispatching member fires, tagged sync (on the member call's stack) or async (a later task): ADR 0361's type sets. The page claims the checker's set per family; an observed synchronous event outside it is `unclaimed`. No family fires `scroll`, so the control handler (App.tsx:172) is never run by a dispatch: its onCleanup is a proven SC4001 violation, and an unclaimed event or a synchronous scroll refutes it. execCommand has no set (AnyType) and is no family: probed once, `insertText` fired `input` and `selectAll` fired `selectstart` synchronously, `copy` and `beforeinput` fired nothing in headless Chrome. A synthetic `MouseEvent`/`PointerEvent` `click` runs the activation behavior (dispatch-mouse-click, dispatch-pointer-click: `input`, `change`), a same-document fragment anchor click fires `beforematch` at a `hidden=until-found` ancestor, and `requestSubmit()` of a `method=dialog` form fires `beforetoggle`. `toggle` and `close` are queued tasks (absent from the synchronous log; probed in a plain page: `requestClose:close@dlg:async`, `toggle@pop:async`), and `change` fires synchronously when a user-edited control loses focus to focus()/blur() (probed with typed input).
